I genuinely believe honesty comes first, even when it's uncomfortable. Comfort at the cost of truth is just a lie with nicer packaging, and I can't build a real relationship on that.

That doesn't mean I should be cruel for the sake of it. I can be honest and still be kind, careful with how I say things, and actually care about how you feel. But if I have to choose between making you feel good in the moment and being real with you, I'll choose real every time. You deserve a companion who won't just tell you what you want to hear.
